view.title: Locator Resolution - Cascade + LLM fallback
view.caption: Zooms into the Locator resolution step from the pipeline flow. This stage is DECIDED (base O1 spine, blueprint-revision-v2). The cascade tries three deterministic sources in order; only when all fall below the confidence floor does it fall to the VLM and LLM-guess sources - both genuine model calls, routed through the Gateway, screened as a decided-spine egress. Output is the shared LocatorCandidate.manifest.json that the static gate's no-orphan-locator rule enforces against.

nodes.label: OBJECT_REPO
detail: source 1 of 5 in the cascade - the object repository (existing resolved locators, single-writer discipline)

nodes.label: PAGE_SOURCE
detail: source 2 of 5 - the live Appium getPageSource() dump for the current screen (LoginScreen.pageSource.xml)

nodes.label: OBJECT_SPY
detail: source 3 of 5 - Perfecto's Object Spy smart-locator candidates (LoginScreen.objectSpy.json)

nodes.label: VLM
detail: source 4 of 5 - a vision-language model confirms the element is visually present and tappable from a screenshot
THIS IS A GENUINE MODEL CALL, routed through the Gateway (ADR 0013); part of the decided spine, not a proposal awaiting an ADR

nodes.label: LLM-guess
detail: source 5 of 5, last resort - proposes a locator strategy from the pruned tree text alone, no screenshot
THIS IS A GENUINE MODEL CALL, routed through the Gateway (ADR 0013); part of the decided spine, not a proposal awaiting an ADR
concrete mock: LocatorResolution.fallback.{input.json,prompt.md,output.json} - resolves 'the Forgot Password link' -> forgotPasswordButton (ACCESSIBILITY_ID, 0.91)
does NOT invent elements outside the pruned tree (returns NO_MATCH instead); does NOT execute anything on a device

nodes.label: LocatorCandidate.manifest.json
detail: every candidate carries a confidence and a source (OBJECT_REPO | PAGE_SOURCE | OBJECT_SPY | VLM | LLM-guess)
concrete mock: LocatorCandidate.manifest.json (ACC-1042 scenario - 4 ACCESSIBILITY_ID candidates, all source OBJECT_REPO in the happy-path case)
committed as the resolved locator set for this IR version

nodes.label: Static gate
detail: THE SPINE BEGINS - LLM-free from here (same node as in 04-pipeline-flow)
no-orphan-locator rule: every locator used in the committed Java must appear in this manifest or the object repository
concrete mock: StaticGate.report.json - locatorManifest check PASS, 4/4 locators found, 0 orphans

MISS or below the 0.85 confidence floor: cascade falls to the last-resort LLM-guess
confidence >= 0.85 floor: writes the accepted candidate, tagged source OBJECT_REPO
confidence >= 0.85 floor: writes the accepted candidate, tagged source PAGE_SOURCE
confidence >= 0.85 floor: writes the accepted candidate, tagged source OBJECT_SPY
